_note: Decode-bench prompt catalog. 'code_tasks' are joined as name + newline + spec + newline + code_tail.

method.measurement: decode window only: (completion_tokens-1)/(last_delta-first_delta); aggregate = sum(decode tokens)/concurrent decode window

prompts.structured: Count from 1 to 200. Output only the numbers, separated by spaces. No other text.
prompts.prose: Write a detailed step-by-step explanation of how a hash map works, including collision handling, resizing, and time complexity. Be thorough.
prompts.json: Emit only a JSON array of fake GPU metrics rows. Each object needs host, gpuIndex, utilPct, tempC, powerW, memUsedMb. Invent many rows. No markdown. Keep expanding the array.
prompts.code_tail: Output only Python source. No comments, no docstrings, no markdown fences. Then add tests and the helpers this needs. Keep writing code.
